items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯车队宣布与K-pop明星TZUYU合作
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队宣布，K-pop艺人TZUYU将为车队与全球动漫IP《DAN DA DAN》的持续合作录制官方主题曲。此前车队在阿塞拜疆大奖赛表现喜忧参半：塞恩斯以第十名获得一个积分，阿尔本则撞车退赛。

items.originalTitle: Williams F1 announces huge K-pop star TZUYU collaboration
items.summaryEn: Williams has announced that K-pop artist TZUYU will record the official theme song for its ongoing partnership with the global anime property DAN DA DAN. The announcement came after a mixed Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend, where Carlos Sainz scored one point with a 10th-place finish and Alex Albon crashed out.
detailZh: 威廉姆斯F1车队宣布与K-pop巨星TZUYU的重大合作
威廉姆斯宣布K-pop明星TZUYU将为车队与《DAN DA DAN》的合作录制官方主题曲
威廉姆斯车队宣布，K-pop艺人TZUYU将为车队与全球动漫IP《DAN DA DAN》的持续合作录制官方主题曲。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛一个喜忧参半的周末之后——卡洛斯·塞恩斯以第十名完赛获得一个积分，而亚历克斯·阿尔本撞车退赛——车队如今将前往三连赛中的下一站。原文称巴林大奖赛将于10月2日至4日在马来西亚举行（原文如此），新加坡大奖赛则定于10月9日至11日举行。
TZUYU 将随这支位于格罗夫的车队前往新加坡，共同庆祝这次合作，前往滨海湾街道赛道观赛的车迷将有机会在威廉姆斯F1车队车迷专区体验特别活动。
“能够参与这次与 Atlassian 威廉姆斯F1车队以及《胆大党》的合作，并演唱官方主题曲，我感到非常荣幸和兴奋，”TZUYU 说道。她既是女团 TWICE 的成员，个人事业也备受瞩目，是韩国流行乐坛最受欢迎的艺人之一。
“把F1、动漫和音乐这三个世界结合在一起，让这个项目独一无二。我相信这次合作将为全球观众带来真正令人兴奋、难以忘怀的作品。
“Atlassian 威廉姆斯F1车队是一支极具标志性和备受尊敬的F1车队，而《胆大党》则是一部以独特视觉风格和动感叙事著称的超人气动漫。我非常期待我们将在官方主题曲及其音乐视频中展现的创意火花。”
威廉姆斯车队商品与授权总监卢克·蒂明斯补充道：“为了庆祝超凡速度的合作，我们只想得到一个声音——而我们很高兴她能加入我们。”
“能请到 TZUYU 加入这次合作，对我们来说是非常令人兴奋的一步，也是我们突破界限、将触角延伸到这项运动之外、触及全世界数百万新粉丝的又一个机会。我们期待这首歌的诞生。”
《胆大党》电视动画制作人龟井博史也评论道：“我们非常激动，《胆大党》能够与我们的全球合作伙伴阿特拉斯·威廉姆斯F1车队以及 TZUYU 一起，在动画的边界之外迎接新的挑战。”
“通过将《胆大党》与一级方程式和音乐的世界结合在一起，我们期待与本作惊人的速度、活力和激情，分享给全世界更多的人。”
“通过与全球多元文化和不同观众群体的联系，我们希望以崭新而激动人心的方式继续拓展《DAN DA DAN》（胆大党）的更多可能性。希望大家都能期待这个非常特别的项目。”
detailEn: Williams F1 announces huge K-pop star TZUYU collaboration
Williams has announced that K-pop star TZUYU will record the official theme song for its DAN DA DAN collaboration
Williams has announced that K-pop artist TZUYU will record the official theme song for its ongoing partnership with the global anime property DAN DA DAN.

Following a mixed weekend at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, where Carlos Sainz collected one point with a 10th-place finish and Alex Albon crashed out, the team now heads to the next stop in the triple-header. The Bahrain Grand Prix, held in Malaysia, will take place from 2-4 October and the Singapore Grand Prix is set for 9-11 October.

TZUYU will join the Grove outfit in Singapore to celebrate the partnership, and fans attending the race weekend at the Marina Bay Street Circuit will have the opportunity to experience special activations in the Williams F1 Team Fan Zone.

“I am truly honoured and excited to be part of this collaboration with Atlassian Williams F1 Team and DAN DA DAN, and to perform the official theme song," TZUYU, one of K-pop's most celebrated performers known for her solo career as well as being part of the girl group TWICE, said.
"Bringing together the worlds of Formula 1, anime, and music makes this project unique, and I believe this collaboration will deliver something truly exciting and memorable for audiences worldwide.

"Atlassian Williams F1 Team is an iconic and highly respected Formula 1 team, while DAN DA DAN is a hugely popular anime known for its distinctive visual style and dynamic storytelling. I am very much looking forward to the creative synergy we will bring to the official theme song and its music video."

Williams' merchandise and licensing director Luke Timmins added: "There’s only one voice we could imagine for a collaboration celebrating supernatural speed – and we’re delighted to have her on board.

"Having TZUYU join us is a really exciting step forward for this collaboration, and another opportunity for us to push the boundaries and reach millions of new fans beyond our sport and around the world. We look forward to seeing the song come to life."

DAN DA DAN TV anime producer Hiroshi Kamei also commented: "We are truly excited that DAN DA DAN has the opportunity to take on a new challenge beyond the boundaries of anime, together with our global partners, Atlassian Williams F1 Team and TZUYU.
"By bringing DAN DA DAN together with the worlds of Formula 1 and music, we look forward to sharing the incredible speed, energy, and excitement of the series with even more people around the world.

"Through connections with diverse cultures and audiences across the globe, we hope to continue expanding the possibilities of DAN DA DAN in new and exciting ways. We hope everyone will look forward to this very special project."
keyPointsZh: 车队接下来将前往三连赛中的下一站巴林大奖赛，随后是新加坡大奖赛。
原文称巴林大奖赛将于10月2日至4日在马来西亚举行（原文如此），新加坡大奖赛定于10月9日至11日举行。
keyPointsEn: The team now heads to the next stop in the triple-header, the Bahrain Grand Prix, followed by the Singapore Grand Prix.
The article states the Bahrain Grand Prix will be held in Malaysia from 2-4 October (as written), with the Singapore Grand Prix set for 9-11 October.

items.summaryZh: 七届F1世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿在社交媒体发文，悼念去世一周年的爱犬罗斯科。这只深受喜爱的英国斗牛犬于2025年9月28日因肺炎治疗期间陷入昏迷后离世。

media.altZh: 汉密尔顿在爱犬罗斯科去世一周年之际发文悼念 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton honours Roscoe with touching tribute one year after his death
items.summaryEn: Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton posted a touching tribute on social media to mark one year since the death of his beloved English Bulldog, Roscoe, who passed away on 28 September 2025 after being placed into a coma while being treated for pneumonia.
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在爱犬罗斯科去世一周年之际发表悼念
刘易斯·汉密尔顿已在他爱犬罗斯科去世一周年之际发表悼念
七届F1世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿在社交媒体发文，悼念去世一周年的爱犬罗斯科。
汉密尔顿在社交媒体上缅怀这只著名的斗牛犬，距离罗斯科离世恰好一年。这只深受喜爱的斗牛犬于2025年9月28日去世，此前因肺炎接受治疗期间被置于昏迷状态。
“罗斯科已经离开我们一年了，”这位法拉利车手发布道，同时附上了一系列罗斯科的照片和视频。“没有我最好的朋友在身边很难受，没有一天我不希望他还在我身边。”
“我每天都想念他和可可，虽然失去他们让我很伤心，但我非常感激曾与他们共度的时光，感谢他们曾出现在我的生命中。”
“他们陪伴我度过了人生中最快乐的一些时光。今天，我翻看着这些照片和视频，开怀大笑，笑容满面，回忆着那些美好的时刻。”
“你们中的很多人都经历过这样的事，并送来了爱与支持。知道罗斯科被这么多人爱着，这对我意义重大。安息吧，伙计们，我永远爱你们。”
在旅行对罗斯科来说变得太辛苦之前，人们经常在F1围场里看到它陪伴在汉密尔顿身边。2013年，前F1首席执行官伯尼·埃克莱斯顿为这只斗牛犬发放了专属的官方围场通行证。它经常出现在车队的房车和F1各大媒体平台上，成为围场里深受欢迎的一员，也是车迷们的最爱。
汉密尔顿敞开心扉，谈到罗斯科离世时他收到的车迷们“势不可挡”的支持。在新加坡大奖赛前，汉密尔顿说：“看到世界各地这么多人的支持真是太棒了，看到罗斯科触动并温暖了这么多人，真是让人感动得难以言表。”
“我收到的那些充满善意的留言真的让我深受鼓舞，对此我非常感激。任何经历过失去宠物的人，都知道那有多痛苦。我曾在某处读到过一句话：悲伤是爱的最后一次表达，我现在确实深有体会。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton honours Roscoe with touching tribute one year after his death
Lewis Hamilton has paid tribute to his late dog Roscoe on the first anniversary of his death
Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton has shared a touching tribute to his late dog Roscoe on the first anniversary of the English Bulldog's passing.

Hamilton has taken to social media to honour the memory of his famous bulldog, Roscoe, exactly one year after his passing. The much-loved bulldog died on 28 September 2025, having been placed into a coma after being treated for pneumonia.

"It’s been one year since Roscoe’s passing," the Ferrari driver posted, alongside a series of photos and videos of Roscoe. "Being without my best friend has been hard, and there’s not a day that goes by that I don’t wish he was with me.
"I think of him and Coco every day, and as sad as I am to not have them, I’m so grateful for the time I shared with them and to have had them in my life.
"They’ve been there for some of the happiest times of my life. Today, I’m looking through these photos and videos, laughing and smiling so big, remembering those moments.
"So many of you have been through this and reached out with love and support. It means so much to me, knowing how much Roscoe was loved. Rest’s in peace buddy’s, love you always."

Roscoe was often seen alongside Hamilton in the F1 paddock before the travel became too much for him. In 2013, former F1 CEO Bernie Ecclestone granted the bulldog his own official paddock pass. Frequently seen in team motorhomes and across F1 media platforms, he became a popular addition to the paddock and a favourite among fans.

Hamilton opened up about the "overwhelming" support he received from fans at the time of Roscoe's passing. "It's been amazing to see the support from so many people around the world, and overwhelming just to see how much Roscoe touched people and meant to people," Hamilton said ahead of the Singapore Grand Prix.

"The kind messages that I've received have been really uplifting, so I'm really grateful for that. Anyone out there that knows what it's like to lose a pet, you know how painful it is. I read somewhere that grief is the last act of love, and I'm definitely feeling that."
keyPointsZh: 这只斗牛犬因肺炎接受治疗期间被置于昏迷状态后离世
keyPointsEn: The bulldog had been placed into a coma after being treated for pneumonia

items.titleZh: 亚历克斯·布伦德尔称维斯塔潘在巴库是拉塞尔的“噩梦燃料”
items.summaryZh: F1电视评论员亚历克斯·布伦德尔表示，阿塞拜疆大奖赛尾声维斯塔潘对拉塞尔的疯狂追击对这位梅赛德斯车手而言是“噩梦燃料”。拉塞尔在安全车后守住领先，以仅0.1秒的优势夺冠。

media.altZh: 亚历克斯·布伦德尔称维斯塔潘在巴库是拉塞尔的“噩梦燃料” · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen was "nightmare fuel" for George Russell in Baku, says Alex Brundle
items.summaryEn: F1 TV pundit Alex Brundle said Max Verstappen's relentless pursuit of George Russell in the closing stages of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix was "nightmare fuel" for the Mercedes driver, who held on to win by just 0.1 seconds after a safety car restart.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在巴库对乔治·拉塞尔而言是“噩梦燃料”，亚历克斯·布伦德尔说
亚历克斯·布伦德尔形容马克斯·维斯塔潘在阿塞拜疆大奖赛尾声对乔治·拉塞尔的追击是“噩梦燃料”
F1电视评论员亚历克斯·布伦德尔表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘在阿塞拜疆大奖赛尾声阶段对乔治·拉塞尔的穷追不舍，对这位梅赛德斯车手来说是“噩梦燃料”。
拉塞尔原本已建立起可观的领先优势，但安全车让全场局面归于中立，重启后他发现自己身后紧跟着维斯塔潘。这位英国车手顶住红牛车手的压力，以仅0.1秒的优势赢下巴库站的比赛。
在亮相F1 Nation播客时，布伦德尔指出了拉塞尔所面临的压力。
他说："另一件事是，你会认为乔治·拉塞尔在锦标赛的这个阶段已经没有什么可输的了，而维斯塔潘基本上也除了争取胜场比赛的机会之外同样没有什么可输的。"
"那种感觉简直像噩梦的燃料，看着马克斯·维斯塔潘从后面追上来，在一套软胎上蹭着墙撞着墙，就在你身后，拼命想让你的比赛尽可能艰难。"
拉塞尔承认，比赛在收尾阶段"变得有些紧张"。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队。
"这是一个非常棒的周末。到最后有点紧张，"这位梅赛德斯车手对天空体育F1说道。"马克斯当时真的在猛烈追赶，我们俩的速度都令人难以置信，我们每圈几乎比其他所有人快上一秒。"
他还补充说，比赛最后一圈出现的黄旗差点让他丢掉胜利。"后来黄旗出现时，我松了油门。等我重新踩下油门时，涡轮增压器没有压力，所以当我失去动力的时候，那就是他差点超越我的时刻。所以，是的，总的来说这是一个很棒的周末。"
拉塞尔在巴库的胜利让他与队友、积分榜领跑者安东内利的差距缩小到66分。安东内利以302分领跑，拉塞尔以236分位居第二，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿以199分排在第三。
detailEn: Max Verstappen was "nightmare fuel" for George Russell in Baku, says Alex Brundle
Alex Brundle described Max Verstappen's late pursuit of George Russell at the Azerbaijan GP as "nightmare fuel"
F1 TV pundit Alex Brundle says Max Verstappen relentlessly hunting down George Russell in the closing stages of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix was "nightmare fuel" for the Mercedes driver.

While Russell had built a commanding lead, the safety car neutralised the field and he found himself with Verstappen right on his heels at the restart. The Briton held on to win the Baku race by just 0.1 seconds, defending against the Red Bull driver.
During an appearance on the F1 Nation podcast, Brundle pointed to the pressure Russell faced.

"The other thing is you think George Russell's got nothing to lose at this stage in the championship, Verstappen properly has nothing to lose apart from the opportunity to take a race victory," he said.
"That is like nightmare fuel, seeing Max Verstappen skidding up, tapping walls on a set of soft tyres behind you, just desperate to make your life as difficult as possible."
Russell admitted that the race "got a bit tense" in the closing stages.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

"It was a great weekend. Got a bit tense towards the end," the Mercedes driver told Sky Sports F1. "Max was really pushing hard and our pace was incredible, the two of us, we were pulling almost a second a lap to everybody else."

He added that a yellow flag on the final lap of the race almost cost him the win. "And then when that yellow flag came out, I backed off. And when I went back on the power, I had no turbo, so when I had no power, that's when he almost passed me. So, yeah, great weekend all in all."

Russell's win in Baku closed the gap to his team-mate and championship leader Kimi Antonelli in the standings to 66 points. Antonelli leads with 302 points, Russell sits second with 236 and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton is third with 199 points.
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔原本建立了可观的领先优势，但安全车使场上局面重新洗牌，重启后维斯塔潘紧贴其身后
拉塞尔最终以0.1秒的优势守住胜利，成功防守了红牛车手
keyPointsEn: Russell had built a commanding lead before the safety car neutralised the field, leaving Verstappen right on his heels at the restart
The Briton held on to win the Baku race by just 0.1 seconds while defending against the Red Bull driver

items.summaryZh: 从印地赛车转战F2追逐F1梦想的科尔顿·赫塔表示，尽管赛季艰难，他仍相信自己有机会在2028年之前登上F1。

media.altZh: 科尔顿·赫塔目标2028年进入F1：“我仍有机会” · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Colton Herta aiming at F1 by 2028: 'I still have a chance'
items.summaryEn: Colton Herta, who switched from IndyCar to Formula 2 in pursuit of his Formula 1 dream, says he still believes he can reach F1 by 2028 despite a difficult season.
detailZh: 科尔顿·赫塔目标2028年进入F1：“我仍有机会”
赫塔的F2赛季堪称炼狱，但他依然瞄准F1——并相信自己能够成功
“坐在这里想着我一上来就能跟上节奏、能在首场比赛就准备好争胜，那是愚蠢的。我可能年纪更大一些，但就速度而言，这些车手一点也不比任何人慢。”
这就是科尔顿·赫塔在追逐F1梦想、从印地赛车转战二级方程式（Formula 2）这场豪赌时的看法，而到目前为止，事实证明他是对的——甚至超出了他最初的想象。
凯迪拉克的青训车手非常清楚，F2对新秀来说是一项艰难的锦标赛，尤其是跳过F3、并且从一开始就得掌握倍耐力轮胎的情况下，但他肯定没料到自己会陷入如今这般困境。
这位效力于Hitech车队的车手目前在车手积分榜上排名第19位，拿到26个积分，最佳成绩是巴塞罗那冲刺赛中的第五名——而且是从反排第三位发车取得的。他完全无法解释为何表现如此不佳。
当Motorsport.com在独家专访中问到究竟是什么让他难以理解时，赫塔回应说：“没有什么特别的具体问题，就是方方面面都不行。不幸的是，任何时候都没有多少积极的方面。不知道为什么，速度完全为零，而且情况基本没有任何改变。”
“我们为什么不能从始至终完整地跑出一个强势的周末，这一点很不明朗。我认为，在这里排位赛比别的车慢三秒，实在是让人挠头。对我来说这完全没有道理。”
当被追问到底是难以适应赛车还是难以适应轮胎时，赫尔塔澄清道：“一开始并不是。在冬季测试中，我们的速度相当不错。我参加的所有私人测试，表现都很强，但不知为何一到比赛周末，这种表现就始终没能转化过来。”
这位美国车手的分析是准确的。在巴塞罗那的季前测试中，他并列第11快，比领跑者拉斐尔·卡马拉慢了0.574秒——卡马拉同样是一名新秀，作为卫冕F3冠军。那样的表现显然令人鼓舞。
但好状态没有持续下去。赫尔塔在前五轮比赛中的平均排位是第14名，与最快者相差0.848秒，而且他的状态逐渐变差，在接下来八节排位赛中平均只排第18名。在后一段时期，平均差距达到1.088秒——这还未算最近巴库站的比赛，那一站他的差距莫名其妙地膨胀到了Q1慢2.484秒、Q2慢3.091秒。
撞车也变得越来越频繁，在最近的蒙扎和马德里这两轮比赛中就有不少于三次。
“这确实令人沮丧，但我们能做的就是继续努力，”赫尔塔补充道。“我不确定这是不是本赛季的最后一场比赛[由于伊朗战争，卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛面临威胁]，还是之后还有更多比赛，但我们会像还有两场比赛要跑一样继续工作。我会尽力从中获得最大收获。”
可以说，这个赛季对于赫尔塔的F1前景来说并不算美好，尤其是考虑到凯迪拉克F1首席执行官丹·托里斯曾期望他能取得年度前10名的成绩，而这一目标如今在数学上已基本无缘。
凯迪拉克曾明确表示，如果这位测试与发展车手在F2中表现足够出色，他在不远的将来就有真正机会获得F1席位，但赫尔塔表示，车队并未就他在这一青训系列赛（feeder series）中的表现向他提供反馈。
这位前印地方程式领跑者还表示，他目前正在与这支F1车队就其2027年的计划进行磋商，并在媒体报道相互矛盾的情况下澄清，他不排除再参加一个赛季F2的可能——尽管这显然不是他的首选。
“我说过‘我没有兴趣’，”赫塔指出。“今年，如果有明显的进步之类的，回到那边会更有意思，但完全没有进步。
“我现在和F1车队做了很多模拟器方面的工作。周一我刚参加了一天旧车测试，效果非常好。无论是在F1模拟器还是TPC测试中，我的速度都很强，但不知为什么，就是没法转化到F2上。”
不过，当被问到2027年是否仍然稳稳属于凯迪拉克时，赫塔回答：“目前我明年还没有任何确定的东西，但我们正在讨论，弄清楚我在车队内部有哪些机会。”
而当我们询问这位2024年印地方程亚军是否会考虑重返该项赛事时，赫塔明确表示了他的优先方向：“一切都取决于明年会是什么样子。我的重心仍然是进入F1，我仍然认为在这两年内我有机会。但我不太确定，我得先看看凯迪拉克对我的计划是什么。
“而一旦我了解了这一点，我就能做出更多决定，比如我是否会在一级方程式（Formula 1）中，还是不会。那会是什么样子，是替补车手的角色？还是仍然是测试车手的角色？如果是那样的话，在那期间我还可以参加哪些其他系列赛来保持忙碌？
“所以，目前确实有很多话只能说，很遗憾，在我对明年的计划更加确定之前，暂时无可奉告——到那时我就可以围绕它来安排一切了。”
detailEn: Colton Herta aiming at F1 by 2028: 'I still have a chance'
Herta’s F2 season has been nothing short of a crucible, yet he’s still aiming at F1 – and believes he can make it

“It would be foolish to sit here and think that I will be on the pace right away, that I will be on the pace and ready to win in my first race. I may be older, but speed-wise, these guys are just as fast as anybody out there.”
This was how Colton Herta viewed his gamble of a Formula 2 switch from IndyCar as he pursued his Formula 1 dream, and he has so far been proven right – actually more than he initially imagined.

Cadillac’s protege was well aware that F2 was a tricky championship for rookies, especially when bypassing F3 and having to master the Pirelli tyres from the get-go, but he certainly didn’t expect to struggle to the extent that he has.

The Hitech driver lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, with 26 points to his name and fifth place in the Barcelona sprint race as his best result – from third on the reversed grid. He is at a loss to explain such a lack of performance.

Asked by Motorsport.com in an exclusive interview what exactly has been tough for him to get his head around, Herta responded: “Nothing in particular, it's just been the whole thing. Unfortunately, there hasn't been a whole bunch of positives at any point. For whatever reason, there's been zero pace, and nothing has really changed.

“It's unclear why we can't put a weekend together from start to finish and it be completely strong. I think it's just a head-scratcher to be qualified three seconds off here. It just makes zero sense to me.”

Pressed on whether he struggled to get used to the car or to the tyres, Herta clarified: “Initially, no. Through the winter testing, we were fairly strong. All the private testing that I’d done, I was strong, but for some reason on race weekends, it just hasn't ever translated.”

The American’s analysis is accurate. He was joint 11th-fastest in pre-season testing at Barcelona, 0.574s down on pacesetter Rafael Camara – also a rookie as the reigning F3 champion. That performance clearly was encouraging.

But it didn’t last. Herta qualified 14th on average in the first five rounds, with a 0.848s deficit to the top, and his form gradually worsened, as he averaged 18th across the next eight qualifying sessions. Over the latter period, the mean gap was 1.088s – discounting the latest Baku event, where his deficit inexplicably ballooned to 2.484s in Q1 and 3.091s in Q2.
Crashes also have been more and more frequent, with no fewer than three across the recent Monza and Madrid rounds.

“It's frustrating, but all we can do is just keep trying,” Herta added. “I guess, unsure if that's the last one [of the season, with Qatar and Abu Dhabi at threat due to the Iran war] or if we have more, but we'll keep working like we have two more races to do. I'll try to get the most out of it.”

It’s fair to say this season hasn’t exactly been amazing for Herta’s F1 prospects, especially given Cadillac F1 CEO Dan Towriss expected a top-10 finish in the championship, which is all but mathematically out of reach.

Cadillac had been clear that its test and development driver had a real chance of an F1 seat in a not-too-distant future if he did well enough in F2, but Herta said he hadn’t had feedback from the team about his performance in the feeder series.

The former IndyCar frontrunner added that he was currently in talks with the F1 outfit regarding his 2027 plans and clarified, amid conflicting media reports, that he wasn’t ruling out a second season in F2 – though this clearly isn’t his priority.
“I said ‘I don't have an interest’,” Herta pointed out. “This year, I think if there was clear progression and whatnot, it would be more interesting to return, but there's zero progression.

“I've been doing a lot more with the F1 team now as far as sim stuff. I just did a TPC [Testing of Previous Cars] day on Monday, which was very strong. On the F1 sim and the TPC stuff, the pace has been really strong, but for whatever reason, it's just not translating to F2.”

Yet, asked if he was still firmly on Cadillac’s books for 2027, Herta replied: “I don't have anything for next year at the moment, but we're discussing, getting through that as far as what the opportunities are for me within the team.”

And when we inquired whether the 2024 IndyCar runner-up would consider a return to the series, Herta made it clear where his priority lay: “It all depends on what next year looks like. My focus is still on getting to F1, and I still think I have a chance of that in these next two years. But I don't know exactly, I have to sit back and see what the plan is for Cadillac for me.

“And once I know that, then I can make more decisions on maybe if I'm in Formula 1, if I'm not. What does that look like in terms of, is it a reserve role? Is it still a test role? If that's the case, what other series can I race in during that to stay busy?
“So, there's a lot of just, like, nothing to say at the moment, unfortunately, until I have more solidified plans for next year – then I can build everything out around that.”
